scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
A human?!
This land is full
of your kind. What
brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
人類？！
這片土地上到處都是你們這些傢伙。
你來這裡幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Living in Midgard and away from
my home town is painful enough, let alone facing a whiny human. Leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
遠離家鄉，住在米德加爾特就已經夠難受了，還得面對你這種囉囉嗦嗦的人類。
別來煩我！

scripts.text: Ask him about Dwarves.
scripts.translation: 打聽矮人的事

scripts.text: Ask him what he is doing.
scripts.translation: 問他在做什麼

scripts.text: Request weapon creation.
scripts.translation: 請求打造武器

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
What's to know about Dwarves?
We're the toughest race. After all, we can live anywhere, no matter
how harsh the environment may be.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
矮人有什麼好打聽的？
我們是最堅韌的種族，無論環境多麼惡劣，都能活下去。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I doubt your feeble mind can comprehend the how unendurable
it must be for you to live in my homeland, but you can try.
Try to imagine.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
要是在我的故鄉生活，你們肯定受不了。
憑你這笨腦袋，恐怕連想都想不到，不過你倒是可以試試。
好好想像一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Most of the knowledge and skills that you humans are so proud of were probably handed down from Dwarves.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
你們人類引以為傲的大部分知識和技能，很可能都是矮人傳授給你們的。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
This is especially true in the
case of smithing. Even the tools and weapons of the gods were made by my ancestors. You know that?
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
鍛造尤其如此。
就連眾神的器具和武器，也是我的祖先打造的。
你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
We have the greatest knowlege and skills, but have accepted our fate to live in the cold, barren lands of the Giants.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我們擁有最淵博的知識和最高超的技藝，卻也認命了，甘願住在巨人那寒冷貧瘠的土地上。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Did you just ask what I am doing here? Mwahahaha! Waiting for any humans stupid enough to come
here so I can kick their ass!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
你問我在這裡做什麼？
嗚哈哈哈ha!
我就等著那些蠢到自己送上門來的人類，好揍他們一頓！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Oh don't worry. I'd only humiliate myself by fighting with a weakling like you. Humans are so fragile, but they stubbornly cling to their arrogance and fight amongst
each other.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
別怕，跟你這種弱者動手，只會丟我自己的臉。
人類明明如此脆弱，卻偏偏傲慢自大，整天自相殘殺。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
As a race, your people are just hopeless. I wouldn't even share the same continent with a human! But alas, I have no choice.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
你們這個種族，真是沒救了。
我連和人類住在同一片大陸上都不願意！
唉，可惜沒得選。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
The path to my hometown
disappeared after the war 1,000 years ago. Somehow, I can no longer find the way through the Yggdrasil Tree that will take me back...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
一千年前的戰爭過後，通往我家鄉的路就消失了。
不知為什麼，我再也找不到穿過世界樹回家的路了...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I'm stuck here in Midgard.
At least I was fortunate enough to find this cave. We Dwarves are most cozy living underground, after all.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我被困在了米德加爾特。
幸好找到了這個洞穴。
畢竟，我們矮人還是住在地下最自在。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I'll need some things to make a weapon for you. What exactly were you interested in having?
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
嗯...
我需要一些材料才能為你打造武器。你具體想要什麼？

scripts.text: Brisingamen
scripts.translation: 女神項鍊

scripts.text: Megingjard
scripts.translation: 雷神腰帶

scripts.text: Sleipnir
scripts.translation: 史雷普尼爾之靴

scripts.text: Mjolnir
scripts.translation: 雷神之錘

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I will need...
^0000FF4 Freya's Jewel
4 Silver Ornament
3 Snow Crystal
3 Ripple
3 Drifting Air
2 Sapphire
3 Pearl
10 Opal
5 Cursed Ruby
20 Gold^000000
1 Necklace^000000...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF4個菲力亞寶石
4個銀飾品
3個雪的結晶
3個漣漪
3個空氣雕像
2個藍寶石
3個珍珠
10個蛋白石
5個詛咒紅寶石
20個金塊^000000
1個項鍊^000000...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
However, the time for me to create this Brisingamen has not yet come. You'll have to wait until the seals are released. Mwahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
不過，打造女神項鍊的時機還沒到。
等封印解除再說吧。
嗚哈哈哈ha!

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I will need...
^0000FF1 Gleipnir
20 Gold
10 Sapphire
10 Oridecon
1 Belt^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF1個魔法鐵鏈
20個金塊
10個藍寶石
10個神之金屬
1個腰帶^000000

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
However, the seals on Megingjard have not yet been released. Until then, you'll have to wait! Bwahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
不過，雷神腰帶的封印還沒解除。
在那之前，你就等著吧！
哈哈哈!

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I will need...
^0000FF3 Wheel of the Unknown
5 Feather of Angel Wing
3 Sprit of Fish
4 Amblem of the Sun God
3 Breath of Spirit
20 Gold
10 Elunium
1 Slotted Boots^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF3個未知的鋸齒輪子
5個天使翅膀羽毛
3個魚的靈魂
4個太陽神的象徵
3個靈魂的呼吸聲音
20個金塊
10個鋁
1雙帶孔靴子^000000

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But even so, I can't create Sleipnir until the seals have been broken. Otherwise, you're out of luck, human. Hahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
可就算如此，封印沒解除，我也造不出史雷普尼爾之靴。
只能算你運氣不好了，人類。
哈哈哈~!

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I will need...
^0000FF2 Thor's Gauntlets
4 Iron Maiden
5 Wrath of Valkyrie
5 Omen of Tempest
5 Billow
20 Oridecon
5 Elunium
40 Gold
1 Stunner^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我需要...
^0000FF2個托爾的鐵手套
4個拷問器具
5個瓦爾基里的憤怒
5個暴風雨的徵兆
5個氣流
20個神之金屬
5個鋁
40個金塊
1個電擊棒^000000

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But I can't even create a replica of Mjolnir if the seals are still in place. Until they're released, you'll just have to wait. Bwahaha!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
封印還在，我連雷神之錘的仿品都造不出來。
等封印解除再說吧。
哈哈!

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
We Dwarves have too much pride to demonstrate our skills in front of a lowly human!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我們矮人自有尊嚴，怎麼能在低賤的人類面前賣弄技藝！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Stop bothering me and get out of here! Go play with some monsters, you simple minded fool!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
別煩我了，快滾出去！去跟那些魔物玩吧，你這個頭腦簡單的蠢貨！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I'll only present
my magnificent skills
to a human of incredibly
high standing!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我只會在地位極其崇高的人類面前，展示我精湛的技藝！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Although I hate
most humans, I have
no choice but to respect the ones chosen by destiny. Go and bring your ^0000FFguildmaster^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我雖然討厭大多數人類，但命運選中的人，我也得尊重。
去把你們的^0000FF公會會長^000000叫來！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Although it is very humiliating to present my valuable skills to a human being...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
雖然向人類展示我寶貴的技藝是一件非常屈辱的事情...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
All the seals have been released, and he who holds the Emperium is chosen by destiny. I have no choice but to respect you.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
所有封印都已解除，而持有華麗金屬的人，正是命運的選中者。
我也只能對你以禮相待。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
First of all, I shall confirm whether or not you have brought all the necessary materials to forge a godly item! I hate it when humans come here without any purpose!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
先讓我看看，你有沒有帶齊打造神器所需的材料！
我最討厭人類無事登門！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFBrisingamen^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
嗯...
看來你是想打造^0000FF女神項鍊^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFMegingjard^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
嗯...
看來你是想打造^0000FF雷神腰帶^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFSleipnir^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
嗯...
看來你是想打造^0000FF史雷普尼爾之靴^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmm...
I guess you
want to have
^0000FFMjolnir^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
嗯...
看來你是想打造^0000FF雷神之錘^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
...
......

[Dwarf Grunburti]
...
......
.........

[Dwarf Grunburti]
How dare you come here unprepared?! Did you forget what you needed to bring? Listen carefully this time!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
竟敢毫無準備就來找我？！
忘了要帶什麼了嗎？
這次給我聽清楚！

scripts.translation: 女神項鍊

scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
嗯，既然封印已經解除了，就得抓緊，別讓其他人類搶先拿到神器...

scripts.text:

Hurry...!
Once I forge
Brisingamen,
the seals will
activate again!
scripts.translation:

快點...！
女神項鍊一旦造好，封印就會重新生效！

scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
快點...！
雷神之錘一旦造好，封印就會重新生效！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Hmpf.
I can't get any work done in here. Come with me to the ^0000FFunderground laboratory^000000 as my guest, human.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
哼，在這裡根本沒法幹活。
人類，跟我到^0000FF地下實驗室^000000去，這次就當你是我的客人。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Now hurry up! ^0000FFOnly one of each godly item^000000 will be given to the humans ^FF0000right after all the seals are released^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
快點！
^0000FF每種神器都只有一件^000000，會在^FF0000所有封印剛解除時^000000交給人類！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Muhahahahahaha!
Out of my sight,
you dirty, filthy
human...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
Muhahahahahaha!
從我眼前消失，你這骯髒的人類...！

scripts.text:
[Entrance Notice]
Only the most
worthy of humans
will possess the
power of the gods.
scripts.translation:
[入口告示]
只有最優秀的人類才能擁有神的力量。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
One of the godly
items has been created,
and the seals have been
restored. You'll have to
wait until they're all
released again...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
已經有一件神器造好了，封印也恢復了。
等所有封印再次解除，你才能有機會...！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Bwahahahahahahaa!
Even though you're
just a human, I feel
pity for you~
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
Bwahahahahahahaa!
雖然你只是個人類，我都有點同情你了~

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
How in the...
Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
怎麼...
給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
How did one of you
stupid humans get in
here?! Only those who
hold the Emperium can
even think of entering
this place...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
你這種蠢人類怎麼進來的？！
只有持有華麗金屬的人，才有資格踏進這裡...！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
It's incredibly
humiliating to do work for a human. But since destiny has chosen you as the bearer of an Emperium, I have no choice but to oblige your requests.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
替人類幹活，簡直是奇恥大辱。
不過，既然命運讓你成為華麗金屬的持有者，我也只能照你的要求辦。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
We only have
^FF000010 minutes^000000 to recreate one godly treasure. After that, the seals will restore themselves and I won't be able to create anything until they're released again...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我們只有^FF000010分鐘^000000來重鑄一件神器。
之後封印會自行恢復，只有再次解除封印，我才能繼續打造神器...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
^FF0000Don't be too slow^000000,
otherwise ^FF0000I will give
the chance to another
human^000000 right away!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
^FF0000動作別太慢^000000，否則^FF0000我會馬上把機會讓給另一個人類^000000！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Now...!
Choose the item
you wish for me
to create!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
現在...！
選吧，要我打造哪一件！

scripts.text: Brisingamen
scripts.translation: 女神項鍊

scripts.text: Megingjard
scripts.translation: 雷神腰帶

scripts.text: Sleipnir
scripts.translation: 史雷普尼爾之靴

scripts.text: Mjolnir
scripts.translation: 雷神之錘

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
B-Brisingamen?!
I've never expected
such insolence...!
This necklace will never have any meaning in my eyes unless it's worn by the goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
女、女神項鍊？！
竟然提出如此無禮的要求...！
在我眼裡，這條項鍊只有戴在女神芙蕾雅身上才有意義。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But who am I to judge your worthiness? These treasures
select their owners with their own will. Let's see if Brisingamen will find you worthy!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
不過，你有沒有資格，也輪不到我來評判。
這些寶物有自己的意志，會自行選擇主人。
就看看女神項鍊認不認可你吧！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Once again, I need following materials in order to reproduce
this godly treasure...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
再說一遍，重鑄這件神器需要以下材料...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
^0000FF4 Freya's Jewel
4 Silver Ornament
3 Snow Crystal
3 Ripple
3 Drifting Air
2 Sapphire
3 Pearl
10 Opal
5 Cursed Ruby
20 Gold
1 Necklace^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
^0000FF4個菲力亞寶石
4個銀飾品
3個雪的結晶
3個漣漪
3個空氣雕像
2個藍寶石
3個珍珠
10個蛋白石
5個詛咒紅寶石
20個金塊
1個項鍊^000000

scripts.text: Make Brisingamen.
scripts.translation: 製作女神項鍊

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Never in my wildest
imaginings have I thought that I'd be crafting this masterpiece for a mere human. Give me a moment.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
做夢都想不到，我竟然會為區區一個人類打造這件傑作。
等一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But...
The seals
have just been
restored. You'll have to
wait until they're all
released again...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
可是...
封印剛剛恢復了。
你得等它們再次全部解除...！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Bwahahahahahahaa!
Even though you're
just a human, I feel
pity for you~
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
Bwahahahahahahaa!
雖然你只是個人類，我都有點同情你了~

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Ah, just look at this dazzling beauty. No other piece of jewelry complemented Freya as well as Brisingamen.
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
啊，看看這耀眼的光彩。
沒有哪件珠寶比女神項鍊更能襯托芙蕾雅的美。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Idiot human!
You didn't bring
everything I need to
recreate Brisingamen!
Hurry...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
愚蠢的人類！
重鑄女神項鍊的材料沒帶齊！
快去拿...！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Muhahahaha~
Somehow, I figured
you'd back out, human!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
Muhahahaha~
我就知道你會打退堂鼓，人類！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
M- Megingjard?!
The girdle of might?!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
雷、雷神腰帶？！
那條力量之帶？！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
This belt was worn long ago by Thor, the mightest warrior ever. But since these treasures select their owners, we'll see whether or not it recognizes you as worthy!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
這條腰帶曾屬於最強大的戰士托爾。
不過，寶物會自行選擇主人，就看看它認不認可你吧！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Once again, I need following materials in order to reproduce
this godly treasure...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
再說一遍，重鑄這件神器需要以下材料...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
^0000FF1 Gleipnir
20 Gold
10 Sapphire
10 Oridecon
1 Belt^000000...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
^0000FF1個魔法鐵鏈
20個金塊
10個藍寶石
10個神之金屬
1個腰帶^000000...

scripts.text: Make Megingjard.
scripts.translation: 製作雷神腰帶

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Twenty years ago,
I'd never believe that
something so powerful and dangerous as Megingjard would end up in the hands of a human...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
二十年前，我絕不會相信像雷神腰帶這樣強大而危險的寶物會落入人類手中...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But...
The seals
have just been
restored. You'll have to
wait until they're all
released again...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
可是...
封印剛剛恢復了。
你得等它們再次全部解除...！

scripts.text:

Even though you're
just a human, I feel
pity for you~
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
Bwahahahahahahaa!
雖然你只是個人類，我都有點同情你了~

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Here...
Be careful with how
you use the strength
of a god. Just a fair
warning, human...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
拿去...
神的力量可不能亂用。
人類，我先提醒你一句...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Idiot human!
You didn't bring
everything I need to
recreate Megingjard!
Hurry...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
愚蠢的人類！
重鑄雷神腰帶的材料沒帶齊！
快去拿...！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Muhahahaha~
Somehow, I figured
you'd back out, human!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
Muhahahaha~
我就知道你會打退堂鼓，人類！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Sleipnir...
Now, understand
that I can't create
the eight-legged stallion
of legend. However...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
史雷普尼爾...
先說清楚，我可造不出傳說中的八足駿馬。
不過...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I can create a pair
of shoes that will possess the power of Sleipnir. It's a strange, but feasible process...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
我能造一雙鞋，讓它擁有史雷普尼爾的力量。
做法雖然古怪，卻確實可行...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Once again, I need following materials in order to reproduce
this godly treasure...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
再說一遍，重鑄這件神器需要以下材料...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
^0000FF3 Wheel of the Unknown
5 Feather of Angel Wing
3 Sprit of Fish
4 Amblem of the Sun God
3 Breath of Spirit
20 Gold
10 Elunium
1 Slotted Boots^000000...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
^0000FF3個未知的鋸齒輪子
5個天使翅膀羽毛
3個魚的靈魂
4個太陽神的象徵
3個靈魂的呼吸聲音
20個金塊
10個鋁
1雙帶孔靴子^000000...

scripts.text: Make Sleipnir.
scripts.translation: 製作史雷普尼爾之靴

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
I never believed
that the speed of
Sleipnir would be
used by a human.
Give me a moment...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
真沒想到，史雷普尼爾的神速竟然會為人類所用。
稍等片刻...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But...
The seals
have just been
restored. You'll have to
wait until they're all
released again...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
可是...
封印剛剛恢復了。
你得等它們再次全部解除...！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Bwahahahahahahaa!
Even though you're
just a human, I feel
pity for you~
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
Bwahahahahahahaa!
雖然你只是個人類，我都有點同情你了~

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
There...
Wear these, and
move with the speed of
the legendary Sleipnir...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
好了...
穿上它，便能像傳說中的史雷普尼爾一樣迅捷...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Idiot human!
You didn't bring
everything I need to
recreate Sleipnir!
Hurry...!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
愚蠢的人類！
重鑄史雷普尼爾之靴的材料沒帶齊！
快去拿...！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Muhahahaha~
Somehow, I figured
you'd back out, human!
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
Muhahahaha~
我就知道你會打退堂鼓，人類！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
M-M-Mjolnir!?
Even though the
moment is at hand,
I can scarcely believe...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
雷、雷、雷神之錘？！
事到臨頭，我卻還是不敢相信...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
This is almost a disgrace to gods and the Dwarf race. But perhaps, wielding Mjolnir may be your destiny...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
^333333*嘆氣...*^000000
這簡直讓眾神和矮人蒙羞。
但也許，揮舞雷神之錘就是你的命運...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Once again, I need following materials in order to reproduce
this godly treasure...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
再說一遍，重鑄這件神器需要以下材料...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
^0000FF2 Thor's Gauntlets
4 Iron Maiden
5 Wrath of Valkyrie
5 Omen of Tempest
5 Billow
20 Oridecon
5 Elunium
40 Gold
1 Stunner^000000...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
^0000FF2個托爾的鐵手套
4個拷問器具
5個瓦爾基里的憤怒
5個暴風雨的徵兆
5個氣流
20個神之金屬
5個鋁
40個金塊
1個電擊棒^000000...

scripts.text: Make Mjolnir.
scripts.translation: 打造雷神之錘

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
Do not disgrace
Thor, lord of Thunder,
or you will regret it.
Mark my words...
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
不要玷汙雷神托爾的名譽，否則你會後悔的。
記住我的話...

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
But...
The seals
have just been
restored. You'll have to
wait until they're all
released again...!
scripts.translation:

可是...
封印剛剛恢復了。
你得等它們再次全部解除...！

scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
Bwahahahahahahaa!
雖然你只是個人類，我都有點同情你了~

scripts.text:
[Dwarf Grunburti]
It's done.
Take it. How does
it feel to hold the world's most powerful weapon in your grasp?
scripts.translation:
[矮人 格倫布林蒂]
完成了。
拿去吧。手握世界上最強大的武器，感覺如何？

scripts.text:

Idiot human!
You didn't bring
everything I need
to recreate Mjolnir!
Hurry...!
scripts.translation:

愚蠢的人類！
重鑄雷神之錘的材料沒帶齊！
快去拿...！
